Products made in China are not always known for safety, and my thoughts were if they can't afford someone to write in English, can they afford to make a safe product?  Well so far so good. The performance is very impressive; it has several settings, I have thick (medium length)hair so of course I set everything to the highest. Heat was perfect, not unbearable. My hair dried SO fast....under ten minutes thoroughly. I'm just so happy I purchased this dryer and for the price, you really can't
Very high quality hair dryer for about $30; performs better than a previously used $80 dryer. Would recommend.
Very good hair dryer. This hair dryer is of professional type and works very well. I recommend it

reviews.t: Awesome hairdryer just like the hairdressers
reviews.x: This hair dryer is the BOMB! It blows air without a lot of noise but it blows hard!. If you are looking to add volume this is the one you want. It is just like the one the hairdressers use. The attachments stay put and don't fall off at the slightest bump. It is top heavy so you have to get used to the weight but this is a quality product.

reviews.t: this is an all out WIN for a hair dryer!
reviews.x: Amazing blow dryer, hot, cold, great air pressure....great price! this is an all out WIN for a hair dryer!

reviews.t: It does an amazing job. Highly recommended
reviews.x: This dryer is so worth the money.  It does an amazing job.  Highly recommended

reviews.t: Not satisfied at all with this product.
reviews.x: I ended up returning this product for a few reasons:  It was much heavier than my older hair dryer!  When turned on, it went hot, then cool, then hot and seemed defective to me.  Took forever to dry my hair!  The switches are in a weird place and I my thumb would accidentally push a switch while in use.  Do not purchase this product!!!  There are better options out there.

Unfortunately, the hair dryer had a few problems. First, it sounded like the armature was off balance as the dryer made a grinding noise. Shortly thereafter it started smoking. I reported the problems to Amazon they told to stop using the hairdryer (no problem there) and rather than return it to simply dispose of it. They also told me they would reimburse me and did so in less than 48 hours. Hairdryer issue was probably a "one of". Amazon response was 5 Stars!

reviews.t: Only order if you want to be screeched at
reviews.x: Terrible--it's louder than any dryer I've ever used, it makes loud screeching noises if you turn it, and it shakes. Not sure if the one I received was just defective, but cannot in good conscience recommend it. Also--when I tried to return it, I was told it was non returnable. Not a great experience.

reviews.t: Love it!  Can't beat the price.
reviews.x: For the price I was amazed to find such a solid sturdy hair dryer.  I've purchased expensive hair dryers in the past, $200+.  This one has the feel and works just as well for under $40.  This is a must!

Item as described.  The motor is very powerful and delivers very strong wind to cut down drying time.  It's a bit on the heavy side, the build quality is one of the best I've seen.  The 2000W motor is just as powerful as the 2100w or the 2200w dryers, since I own a 2100w and a 2200w dryer as well.  This is also the most quietest motor of all the dryers that I've owned.  Highly recommended if your looking for a high quality and powerful dryer.

This is the best blow dryer I have ever used!  My super thick hair dries in no time.  I love the low heat setting cause I burn up while I blow dry my hair.  But on this setting and on high speed  I not only does my hair dry ...I'm not dripping in sweat.  I will be buying another for my daughter.  She  is going to school to be a hair dresser I think she will love this.  Plus it has a super long cord.
This is an awesome hair dryer. Super powerful and strong. It has a long cord and various speed and temperature. I really recommend this hair dryer if you are looking for a great price and quality.

reviews.t: The heat settings and blower settings are great and I love the diffuser
reviews.x: I have had the dryer for several months now and it works very well. The  heat settings and blower settings are great and I love the diffuser.  I recommend this dryer.

reviews.t: Broke within the first week I had it
reviews.x: I just received it October 19th and today is the 30th.and it already does not have hot air coming out of it it broke
Cut your drying time in half. This machine is worth it.

reviews.t: GREAT hair dryer.  Dries hair quickly and leaves it smooth!
reviews.x: Best hair dryer I've used-- you can tell it's 2000 watts versus your typical 1875.  It dries hair very quickly and leaves it very smooth.  I feel like I am doing an at-home blow out.  The attachments fit great and the hot air gets VERY hot.  Be careful as you can burn your neck a little bit if you're not paying attention.  It's a little heavy but it feels sturdy so it doesn't bother me.  I've only had it a couple weeks but I already really like it; it definitely works like a $150+ dryer.  Defini

reviews.t: great dryer and great price - can't go wrong!
reviews.x: I usually use a salon level hairdryer because I have super thick and long hair. And I don't like to spend an hour blow drying my hair. So when my "expensive" hairdryer died on me and I had to send it back to get it covered under warranty, I ordered this one as my back up and then to use as my travel hairdryer. I was totally amazed at how well it worked. It worked as well as my Rusik and Chi hairdryers at a fraction of the price. I highly recommend. And all the attachments are a bonus!

reviews.t: My hair never looked sooo good!!
reviews.x: Best dryer on the planet! I am so glad I ignored the write ups online and even on the product box. Horrible English! This dries my long thick hair in less than 10 minutes and with a round brush it comes out wavy, shiny and salon-like every time!

I really can blow my hair dry in 4 minutes with this dryer! My hair is short however it took me much longer with my old Conair. This dryer is indeed professional quality. I am so happy with it and the price! I get ready much faster now.

Love my new hair dryer, my old hair dryer decided to quit working on a Monday morning! I jumped on Amazon and ordered this one! Absolutely love it, it's even better than my old one, much more powerful.
Solid build quality  and not as loud as expected. Also like that the attachments actually stay on. Furthermore, as a man I have no idea what the big dome with forks is supposed to be used for.

reviews.x: I have used this hair dryer for a week now and it is amazing. My hair is a tad bit shinier and softer than letting it air dry then flat ironing it. The dryer is slightly heavier in my hand than the cheap ones in the store. The air flow is powerful which is 2000w. It also has 3 settings for the temp which I find the middle one is the best. Great product and customer service.  Worked perfectly for one month. Strong and hot. After one month the hair dryer started to whistle very loudly. Gets worse everyday.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the dryer's strong performance and value, with many saying it works as well as or better than more expensive dryers.
Several reviewers note the dryer is heavy or top-heavy.
Some reviewers report defects or problems, including overheating, grinding noises, smoking, and screeching.
Reviewers appreciate the included attachments, such as the diffuser and comb, and note they stay in place.
A few reviewers express concerns about build quality or durability, including poor English on the box and a defective unit.
